scripts.fix: vp run format && vp run lint:fix
scripts.check: vp run lint && vp run format:check && vp run check:no-js-source && vp run typecheck && vp run benchmark:parser && vp run test:unit
scripts.verify: vp run fix && vp run check
scripts.dev: vp run build:frontend && vp exec wrangler dev --test-scheduled
scripts.deploy: vp run build:frontend && vp exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && vp exec wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate:local: vp exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: vp exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.test:migrations: vp run check:migrations && vp exec tsx scripts/run-quiet.ts tsx scripts/verify-migration-upgrade.ts
scripts.docs:api: vp dlx -p typedoc-plugin-markdown@4.12.0 -p typedoc-vitepress-theme@1.1.3 -p typescript@6.0.2 typedoc@0.28.20
scripts.docs:openapi:check: vp run docs:openapi:generate && REDOCLY_TELEMETRY=off REDOCLY_SUPPRESS_UPDATE_NOTICE=true vp dlx -p @redocly/cli@2.47.0 redocly lint --extends=minimal docs/public/generated/openapi.json
scripts.docs:openapi: vp run docs:openapi:check && REDOCLY_TELEMETRY=off REDOCLY_SUPPRESS_UPDATE_NOTICE=true vp dlx -p @redocly/cli@2.47.0 redocly build-docs docs/public/generated/openapi.json --output docs/public/generated/openapi.html
scripts.docs:architecture:check: vp dlx -p typescript@6.0.2 dependency-cruiser@18.1.0 src frontend --config .dependency-cruiser.json --ts-config tsconfig.json --output-type err
scripts.docs:architecture: vp exec tsx scripts/ensure-directories.ts docs/public/generated && vp dlx -p typescript@6.0.2 dependency-cruiser@18.1.0 src frontend --config .dependency-cruiser.json --ts-config tsconfig.json --output-type html --output-to docs/public/generated/dependencies.html && vp dlx -p typescript@6.0.2 dependency-cruiser@18.1.0 src frontend --config .dependency-cruiser.json --ts-config tsconfig.json --collapse 2 --output-type mermaid --output-to docs/public/generated/architecture.mmd && vp exec tsx scripts/docs/render-mermaid-architecture.ts docs/public/generated/architecture.mmd docs/public/generated/architecture.html
scripts.docs:generate: vp run docs:api && vp run docs:openapi && vp run docs:architecture && vp run docs:ai:stage && vp run docs:db
scripts.docs:build: vp run docs:generate && vp exec vitepress build docs
scripts.docs:dev: vp run docs:generate && vp exec vitepress dev docs
scripts.typecheck: vp run types:worker && vp exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.types:worker: vp exec tsx scripts/ensure-directories.ts .generated && vp exec tsx scripts/run-quiet.ts wrangler types .generated/worker-configuration.d.ts
scripts.build: vp run build:frontend && vp run build:worker && vp run build:admin-worker && vp run build:lambda
scripts.build:frontend: vp run build:frontend:public && vp run build:frontend:admin
scripts.build:admin-worker: vp exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.admin.jsonc --outdir dist/admin-worker
